title: New Immigration Processing Center Expected to Open in Laredo Next November
excerpt: A new immigration processing center is expected to open in Laredo next November, and the Holding Institute says it is preparing to help people released from the center.
content:
A new immigration processing center is expected to open in Laredo next November, and the Holding Institute says it is preparing for the people who may be released from it.

Holding Institute Executive Director Mike Smith said the center could streamline a process that now sends people to detention centers across the United States and in Central Texas. If people are sent to South Texas instead, he said, the institute would have better access to them to provide care, comfort and counsel.

Smith said people detained at the new center who are eventually released with a new court date would likely be released into the institute’s care, so the institute can help process them and help them return to their homes in the United States.

The Holding Institute helps people released from detention, offering them a place to sleep and sometimes food and clothing. Smith said the institute usually helps 8 to 10 people a day, down from previous years.

No operator for the center, no capacity and no specific address or neighborhood in Laredo were given.

Sources: KGNS — “Holding Institute director weighs in on Laredo processing center, immigration”, Nov. 25, 2026
